title: "Tree Ring Data Visualization"
format: html
editor: visual

## Histograms of ringwidth

#### Alberta

```{r}
alberta <- read.csv("alberta.csv", header=TRUE)

hist(alberta$Ring_width.mm., main="Observed ringwidth across all trees and years in Alberta", xlab="Ring Width (mm)", col="green")
```

#### Arizona

```{r}
arizonabog <- read.csv("arizonabog.csv", header=TRUE)
arizonadec <- read.csv("arizonadec.csv", header=TRUE)
arizonaPIPO <- read.csv("arizonaPIPO.csv", header=TRUE)

#append arizona data sets into one
arizona <- rbind(arizonabog, arizonadec, arizonaPIPO)

hist(arizona$Ring_width.mm., main="Observed ringwidth across all trees and years in Arizona", xlab="Ring Width (mm)", col="green")
```

#### British Columbia

```{r}
bc <- read.csv("bc.csv", header=TRUE)

#filter out all data from 2023 (no ringwidth was recorded and all the input says "999" which skews the histogram)

filter_out_999 <- subset(bc, Ring_width.mm. != 999)

hist(filter_out_999$Ring_width.mm., main="Observed ringwidth across all trees and years in British Columbia", xlab="Ring Width (mm)", col="green")
```

#### Colorado

```{r}
coloradoclemons <- read.csv("coloradoclemons.csv", header=TRUE)

coloradobirch <- read.csv("coloradobonanzacreekbirch.csv", header=TRUE)

coloradospruce <- read.csv("coloradobonanzacreekspruce.csv", header=TRUE)

coloradocolumbine <- read.csv("coloradocolumbine.csv", header=TRUE)

coloradoduke <- read.csv("coloradoduke.csv", header=TRUE)

coloradoLPP <- read.csv("coloradoLPP.csv", header=TRUE)



#subset datasets into only the needed columns
subset_coloradoclemons <- coloradoclemons[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]

subset_coloradobirch <- coloradobirch[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]

subset_coloradospruce <- coloradospruce[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]

subset_coloradocolumbine <- coloradocolumbine[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]

subset_coloradoduke <- coloradoduke[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]

subset_coloradoLPP <- coloradoLPP[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]


#append all colorado datasets into one
colorado <- rbind(subset_coloradoclemons, subset_coloradobirch, subset_coloradospruce, subset_coloradocolumbine, subset_coloradoduke, subset_coloradoLPP)

hist(colorado$Ring_width.mm., main="Observed ringwidth across all trees and years in Colorado", xlab="Ring Width (mm)", col="green")

```

#### Montana

```{r}
montanacore <- read.csv("montanacore.csv", header=TRUE)
montanagrowth <- read.csv("montanagrowth.csv", header=TRUE)
ACRUm <- read.csv("ACRUmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
ACRUup <- read.csv("ACRUupslope.csv", header=TRUE)
BELEm <- read.csv("BELEmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
LITUm <- read.csv("LITUmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
LITUup <- read.csv("LITUupslope.csv", header=TRUE)
QUALm <- read.csv("QUALmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
QUALup <- read.csv("QUALupslope.csv", header=TRUE)
QUMOm <- read.csv("QUMOmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
QUMOup <- read.csv("QUMOupslope.csv", header=TRUE)
QURUm <- read.csv("QURUmesic.csv", header=TRUE)
QURUup <- read.csv("QURUupslope.csv", header=TRUE)


#subset datasets into only the needed columns
subset_montanacore <- montanacore[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_montanagrowth <- montanagrowth[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_ACRUm <- ACRUm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_ACRUup <- ACRUup[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_BELEm <- BELEm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_LITUm <- LITUm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_LITUup <- LITUup[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QUALm <- QUALm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QUALup <- QUALup[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QUMOm <- QUMOm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QUMOup <- QUMOup[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QURUm <- QURUm[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]
subset_QURUup <- QURUup[, c("X","Ring_width.mm.")]


#append all montana datasets into one
montana <- rbind(subset_montanacore, subset_montanagrowth, subset_ACRUm, subset_ACRUup, subset_BELEm, subset_LITUm, subset_LITUup, subset_QUALm, subset_QUALup, subset_QUMOm, subset_QUMOup, subset_QURUm, subset_QURUup)

hist(montana$Ring_width.mm., main="Observed ringwidth across all trees and years in Montana", xlab="Ring Width (mm)", col="green")
```

## Tree-Level Time Series

#### Alberta

```{r}

I001013 <- subset(alberta, Tag == "I001013")

plot(I001013$years, y = I001013$Ring_width.mm., type = "o", col="darkgreen", xlab= "Time (in years)", ylab = "Ring Width (mm)", main = "Ring Width of I001013 Tag Over Time")

I131953 <- subset(alberta, Tag == "I131953")

plot(I131953$years, y = I131953$Ring_width.mm., type = "o", col="darkgreen", xlab= "Time (in years)", ylab = "Ring Width (mm)", main = "Ring Width of I131953 Tag Over Time")
```
